name: com.engagelab.privates.push.platform.mi.callback.MTMiCallback
description: Xiaomi Mi Push sends registration results, notification arrivals or clicks, and call messages to this EngageLab receiver. It forwards those events to EngageLab’s push or call handling.
disableEffect: Xiaomi-delivered EngageLab notifications stop, and apps that rely on its call messages may miss incoming calls.
